mapper.sql: p.post_id, p.post_no, p.board_type, coalesce(nullif(m.nickname, ''), nullif(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code, '未知商户') as merchant_name, m.member_code, p.category, p.brand, p.model_name, p.memory_spec, p.condition_level, p.quantity, p.price_range_code, p.city, p.service_tags, p.recent_30d_turnover, p.idle_qty, p.rented_qty, p.long_idle_qty, p.post_status, p.down_rank_flag, (select count(1) from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_report pending_report where pending_report.post_id = p.post_id and pending_report.report_status = 0 and pending_report.is_delete = 0) as pending_report_count, date_format(p.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time, p.remark
mapper.select:
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post p left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.member_id = p.member_id and m.is_delete = 0
p.is_delete = 0
and (p.post_no like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or p.brand like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or p.model_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or m.member_code like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or m.nickname like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or m.legal_subject_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
and p.board_type = #{query.boardType} and p.post_status = #{query.postStatus} and p.city like concat('%', #{query.city}, '%')
order by pending_report_count desc, p.create_time desc, p.post_id desc
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post p left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.member_id = p.member_id and m.is_delete = 0 where p.post_id = #{postId} and p.is_delete = 0

select r.report_id, r.post_id, p.post_no, coalesce(nullif(reporter.nickname, ''), nullif(reporter.legal_subject_name, ''), reporter.member_code, '未知商户') as reporter_name, coalesce(nullif(reported.nickname, ''), nullif(reported.legal_subject_name, ''), reported.member_code, '未知商户') as reported_merchant_name, r.report_type, cast(r.evidence_json as char) as evidence, r.report_status, r.review_result, reviewer.nick_name as reviewer_name, date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(r.review_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as review_time from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_report r left join ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post p on p.post_id = r.post_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member reporter on reporter.member_id = r.reporter_member_id and reporter.is_delete = 0 left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member reported on reported.member_id = r.reported_member_id and reported.is_delete = 0 left join `ry-cloud`.sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id = r.reviewer_id and reviewer.is_delete = 0
r.is_delete = 0
and (p.post_no like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or r.report_type like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or reporter.nickname like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or reported.nickname like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or reporter.legal_subject_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or reported.legal_subject_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
and r.report_status = #{query.reportStatus} and p.city like concat('%', #{query.city}, '%')
order by field(r.report_status, 0, 1, 2), r.create_time desc, r.report_id desc

select r.report_id, r.post_id, p.post_no, coalesce(nullif(reporter.nickname, ''), nullif(reporter.legal_subject_name, ''), reporter.member_code, '未知商户') as reporter_name, coalesce(nullif(reported.nickname, ''), nullif(reported.legal_subject_name, ''), reported.member_code, '未知商户') as reported_merchant_name, r.report_type, cast(r.evidence_json as char) as evidence, r.report_status, r.review_result, reviewer.nick_name as reviewer_name, date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(r.review_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as review_time from ry_rental.ry_rental_market_report r left join ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post p on p.post_id = r.post_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member reporter on reporter.member_id = r.reporter_member_id and reporter.is_delete = 0 left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member reported on reported.member_id = r.reported_member_id and reported.is_delete = 0 left join `ry-cloud`.sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id = r.reviewer_id and reviewer.is_delete = 0 where r.report_id = #{reportId} and r.is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update ry_rental.ry_rental_market_report set report_status = #{reportStatus}, review_result = #{reviewResult}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_time = now() where report_id = #{reportId} and report_status = 0 and is_delete = 0
update ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post set post_status = #{postStatus}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where post_id = #{postId} and is_delete = 0
update ry_rental.ry_rental_market_post set down_rank_flag = #{downRankFlag}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where post_id = #{postId} and is_delete = 0
